name: scg-prototypes
description: Publish frontend prototypes to the SCG prototype channel and return shareable URLs.

interface.shortDescription: Publish a prototype and get a shareable URL.
interface.longDescription: Publishes a built static prototype to the private-backend, CloudFront-fronted SCG prototype channel, archives it in git, and returns the URL with its 30 day expiry.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the publish-prototype skill to publish this prototype and give me the URL.
